parents.course: Sem for Adv Stu of Education

ns2:section.sectionText: This doctoral seminar introduces students to the Language and Literacy program area. Faculty will present and lead discussion of key topics for new scholars, including program policies, procedures, and milestones; professionalism and ethics in the academy; publications and editorial boards; and presenting at scholarly conferences. We will meet on Friday afternoons (4:00-6:00) four times during the semester.
